subject.title: [Feature]: Make the Control UI sidebar resizable

question: Should OpenClaw accept a persisted, user-resizable desktop Control UI primary sidebar width now, and should the existing navWidth setting become the product contract for it?
rationale: This is a protected maintainer-labeled feature that turns an existing dormant local setting into active layout behavior, so automation should not choose the default/clamp/upgrade semantics.

options.title: Sponsor focused resizable sidebar
options.body: Implement the desktop-only resize handle with existing Control UI primitives, reuse navWidth, and require browser proof for expanded, collapsed, and mobile drawer modes.

options.title: Defer to broader navigation UX
options.body: Keep the fixed sidebar width until maintainers do a wider navigation/sidebar design pass.

options.title: Prioritize display names instead
options.body: Continue reducing long-label confusion through the shared session display-name work while leaving the primary sidebar width fixed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused resizable sidebar
recommendation.body: Implement the desktop-only resize handle with existing Control UI primitives, reuse navWidth, and require browser proof for expanded, collapsed, and mobile drawer modes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete filed and is assigned to this protected issue and has the strongest recent product context for the adjacent Control UI split/session work.
